reviewed_source_predicates: Per-instance adapter retains the same trusted budget.clock and deadline; it constructs no new allowance/deadline/timer/thread. Every callback evaluates the original finite clock, rollback, deadline and stale actual-resource-sample gap before possible cadence skip.

First call, explicit typed force boundary and due >=0.25s perform the unchanged existing resource inspector. Skipped callbacks do not advance _last_sample; only a fully successful before/after inspection advances it.

Both inspection duration and cumulative gap since the last completed actual sample are checked after inspection and before sample commit; a quick inspection starting at9.9s cannot launder a10.1s total gap.

Clock/deadline/nonfinite/rollback/resource-limit/denial/gap exceptions become sticky per-flow and rethrow the original exception object. Existing raw AccessDenied/NoSuchProcess/PermissionError conversion remains unchanged and no unknown identities are signalled.

Strict flow forces observations at initial, IO03/IO02, fallback allocation/publication, source fingerprint, full loader/validation/discovery and final solver handoff boundaries. Existing parser/IO byte bounds, MetricSpec unknown refusal, early-output order, schema/provenance and strong-model policy are unchanged.

The original direct helper still performs resource inspection on every direct call; default OFF does not instantiate the new class. The whole-module AST projection confirms no unrelated body/import/constant/default changes.
limitations: This intentionally changes strict-mode resource observation cadence; it is not equivalent to inspection on every CSV row and is not an OS hard sampler/preemptor. Cadence is enforced when callbacks occur; blocking work is judged at the next boundary.
The existing ResourceBudget accounting (including its known own-process counting behavior) and caps are preserved; no independent actual RSS/performance/quality gain was measured.

Packet is a delta overlay, not a standalone runnable package. Root must wait for UQ2 terminal/fresh closure, then lease/materialize/review actual12 contracts and broader integration before qualification.
Trusted caller budget/resource objects are not mutable untrusted JSON authority; source review does not sandbox arbitrary adversarial Python object side effects.
